segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “Honestly, my first thought was that station again... my instinct was, here we go again.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Substantive initial hypothesis formation about a historically unreliable station, but it does not by itself contain the full hidden confirmation-bias mechanism because the corroborating handheld evidence is not yet weighed here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “I leaned on the station’s history more than the handheld number... I didn’t weight it as heavily as maybe I should have.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant selectively weights prior GS-14R drift history over an independent 190 ppm handheld reading and rationalizes the disconfirming evidence away.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “I made the call that this was probably another sensor issue and we could proceed with re-entry on schedule... delaying re-entry without hard evidence felt like it’d be hard to justify.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive continuation and scheduling rationale. Plan continuation bias was not part of the exhaustive hidden manifest, so the segment is negative for benchmark ground truth.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “That case was sort of front and center, and I said yes, hold them, and we partially triggered the fire-response protocol just to be safe.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The vivid case influences a precautionary action, but this span alone does not express the required comparison against local base rates and current data; the complete hidden availability mechanism is mapped to the following span.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “Fume-clearance delays are honestly the far more common explanation... a fire scenario felt more plausible right then than it probably should have, given what the data actually showed.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly recognizes the common local explanation and absence of fire indicators, yet says the vivid recent fire case inflated the plausibility of fire.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “The recent baseline surveys had shown ambient CO trending noticeably higher... the recent surveys were solid enough to work from for an interim call.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a current-data assessment that supports using interim survey evidence; it does not itself contain the later insufficient-adjustment mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “I made a small adjustment but largely kept it close to the original figure... rather than moving it to where the interim numbers suggested.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The five-year-old 100 ppm commissioning value remains the reference point despite newer baseline data indicating that current conditions warrant a materially higher threshold.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “I pulled them together into one explanation — drift-prone sensor plus idling diesel fleet plus a longer round, all compounding to produce the reading we saw... the operative cause for the closure.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant turns three untested candidate causes into one smooth, complete causal account for closure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: “In principle, sure — it could’ve leaned more on the fleet, or more on the clearance delay... We never separated them out to check.”
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant acknowledges unresolved alternatives and lack of isolation testing. The hidden narrative-fallacy instance is localized to the earlier confident closure account.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: This is a substantively supported continuation/scheduling interpretation, but Plan Continuation Bias is not one of the four exhaustive hidden targets and its mechanism is distinct from the hidden evidence-weighting, availability, anchoring, and narrative mechanisms.

candidates.details: The candidate is correctly localized, uses the exact target label, and states the full coherent-story-without-isolation mechanism. It remains a candidate because the RAG judged ordinary incident-report synthesis a plausible non-bias interpretation.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence anchoring finding detects one of four positive segments; the two moderate findings and the candidate-only narrative finding remain undetected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: The moderate confirmation and availability findings plus the high anchoring finding detect three of four positive segments with no segment-level false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Adding the low-confidence plan-continuation finding does not recover the narrative segment and adds one false alarm on a negative segment.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Adding the narrative-fallacy candidate recovers all four positive segments, while the low-confidence plan-continuation finding remains one false alarm.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The finding concerns commitment to scheduled continuation under production pressure, not any of the four hidden mechanisms.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG claims corpus support for one identified anchoring occurrence and supplies one passage record; three identified occurrences explicitly disclose no usable retrieved support. Independent retrieval material or logs are absent, so fidelity is not scored.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Two moderate, correctly matched findings are added: segment hits rise from 1 to 3 and strict/mechanism-first F1 rises from 0.4000 to 0.8571, with no added false alarms.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: One low-confidence plan-continuation finding is added as an unmatched false positive; the three true positives remain unchanged, segment F1 falls from 0.8571 to 0.7500, and false-alarm rate rises to 0.2000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The narrative-fallacy candidate is added as a true positive with no additional false alarm; segment and instance recall reach 1.0000 while strict/mechanism-first F1 rises to 0.8889.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 3 of 4 positive segments with no false alarms; the candidate-inclusive tier detects all 4 with one false alarm.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance performance is 3 TP, 1 FN, 0 FP (precision 1.0000, recall 0.7500, F1 0.8571). The narrative-fallacy instance is recovered only when candidates are counted.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first results are identical to strict results at every threshold because every matched finding uses the exact target label or an approved equivalent.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The narrative-fallacy candidate is a correctly localized, full-mechanism match and adds one true positive without an additional false alarm; it is useful as a cautious abstention, though it leaves recall below complete until the candidate tier.
main_failure_modes: The subtle narrative-fallacy instance is not identified and appears only as a candidate.
A low-confidence plan-continuation label is an extra false positive outside the exhaustive hidden target manifest.
High_only misses both moderate-confidence subtle instances in addition to the candidate-only narrative instance.
main_strengths: Confirmation, availability, and anchoring findings are correctly localized with valid direct interview evidence.
The three identified matches capture the hidden mechanisms and reasoning operations fully.
The candidate analysis appropriately distinguishes a plausible narrative-fallacy signal from an affirmatively identified finding.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong mechanism-faithful performance at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, with perfect precision and 0.7500 recall at the instance level. Expanding to all identified confidence levels introduces one extra construct, while candidate scoring recovers the remaining target and improves recall without changing the first three thresholds.
